root.name: ジャズ・ファーマシューティカルズ

rows.ja: 競合(各社の資料に記載)

companies.name: GWファーマシューティカルズ

relations.text: 2021年5月に買収し、てんかん薬エピディオレックスを獲得
relations.text_en: Acquired in May 2021, adding the epilepsy drug Epidiolex

source.label: Jazz 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We acquired Epidiolex (Epidyolex outside the U.S.) in May 2021 as part of our GW Acquisition

relations.text: HER2二重特異性抗体ジイヘラの独占開発・販売権を導入
relations.text_en: In-licensed exclusive rights to the HER2 bispecific Ziihera (zanidatamab)

source.label: Jazz 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We acquired our exclusive development and commercialization rights to Ziihera in 2022 through an exclusive licensing and collaboration agreement with a subsidiary of Zymeworks

relations.text: 2025年4月に約9.4億ドルで買収し、Modeysoを獲得
relations.text_en: Acquired in April 2025 for $944.2 million, adding Modeyso

source.label: Jazz 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: In April 2025, we acquired the entire issued share capital of Chimerix at a price of $ 8.55 per share, payable in cash at closing, representing a total cash consideration of $ 944.2 million

companies.name: ウェアウルフ・セラピューティクス

relations.text: JZP898(WTX-613)の世界独占ライセンスを導入

source.label: Jazz 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We acquired rights to JZP898 from Werewolf in 2022 under an exclusive, worldwide, royalty-bearing license

relations.text: 共同研究と資産譲受でJZP815の権利を取得
relations.text_en: Acquired JZP815 rights through a collaboration and asset purchase

source.label: Jazz 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Through a collaboration agreement and an asset purchase agreement with Redx in 2019, we acquired a portfolio of U.S. and ex-U.S. patents and patent applications, including rights relating to compositions and methods of using JZP815.

relations.text: 小細胞肺がん薬ゼプゼルカの米国権利の導入元
relations.text_en: Licensor of U.S. rights to the lung cancer drug Zepzelca

source.label: Jazz 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our exclusive U.S. development and commercialization rights to Zepzelca were acquired through an exclusive license agreement we entered into with PharmaMar in December 2019.

relations.text: アバデル買収で得たLumryzがXywav・Xyremと競合
relations.text_en: Its Lumryz, gained with Avadel, competes with Xywav and Xyrem

source.label: Jazz 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Xywav and Xyrem face competition from Alkermes' Lumryz (acquired through its acquisition of Avadel)

companies.name: アクサム・セラピューティクス

relations.text: 2022年にジャズから取得したSunosiが競合
relations.text_en: Sunosi, bought from Jazz in 2022, competes with its oxybates

source.label: Jazz 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Xywav and Xyrem face competition from Sunosi, which we sold to Axsome in 2022.

companies.name: ハーモニー・バイオサイエンシズ

relations.text: WAKIXの競合としてジャズのXyremを挙げる
relations.text_en: Names Jazz's Xyrem among WAKIX competitors

source.label: Harmony 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Jazz Pharmaceuticals' Xyrem (sodium oxybate) is an FDA-approved product for the treatment of cataplexy or EDS in patients 7 years of age and older with narcolepsy.

relations.text: 2025年9月に高ナトリウム・オキシベートの後発品が承認
relations.text_en: Its generic high-sodium oxybate was approved in September 2025

source.label: Jazz 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: including a generic version of high-sodium oxybate from Amneal approved in September 2025

relations.text: ゾジェニクスを買収し希少てんかんで競合
relations.text_en: Acquired Zogenix and competes in rare epilepsies

source.label: Jazz 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: In March 2022, UCB S.A. announced that it had completed its acquisition of Zogenix.
